title: AI infrastructure at scale: financing the power-constrained grid
discussion_signal: The panel connects AI infrastructure financing to generation, grids, storage, data centers, insurance, regulatory constraints, rate design, consumer affordability, and public acceptance. It treats finance and infrastructure as one connected deployment problem.
linked_research_question: How capital, infrastructure, regulation, and cost recovery shape the social and material feasibility of AI deployment.
limits: Institutional panel and description are curated speech, not audience evidence
No causal investment or affordability outcome is measured
